findings.observed_result: Git observed a dirty worktree, including untracked state, while the runtime freshness/context outputs reported no modified or untracked files and source/runtime change counts of zero.
findings.required_remediation: Implement VAL-WORKTREE-EVIDENCE-001 so DB freshness reports the same declared Git observation scope used by audit evidence.

findings.observed_result: Clean disposable worktree and ignored-file boundary controls were not executed.
findings.required_remediation: Add an isolated disposable worktree or transaction-safe fixture mode for clean and ignored-file worktree controls.

findings.observed_result: No executable production admission pipeline validator entry point was found.
findings.required_remediation: Implement a real admission validator that exercises canonical admission packet validation, governed extraction, and canonical provenance queries.

findings.observed_result: No executable production runtime-authority exclusion validator entry point was found.
findings.required_remediation: Implement runtime authority tests proving unadmitted, proposed, rejected, superseded, deferred, and provenance-incomplete objects cannot enter authoritative runtime context.

findings.observed_result: No executable Markdown assertion to canonical object/version resolver was found.
findings.required_remediation: Implement projection trace validation for governed Markdown assertions.

findings.observed_result: No executable projection snapshot freshness comparator was found.
findings.required_remediation: Implement projection freshness validation against canonical database snapshot identity and validator run status.

findings.observed_result: No executable validator was found that rejects untyped or overloaded status labels.
findings.required_remediation: Implement typed status namespace validation for claim, rigor, theorem, formalization, and validation statuses.

findings.observed_result: No executable canonical-expression semantic resolver was found.
findings.required_remediation: Implement object-ID based expression resolution with typed permitted variants and quarantine for corrupted encodings.
